scenarios.title: List books by query
scenarios.given: Two books exist (id 1 with isbn '1234567890', id 2 with different isbn)
scenarios.then: 200 with a JSON list containing the book id 1

scenarios.title: Unknown query param
scenarios.then: 400 with {'error': 'id is not a valid query parameter'}

logic: > In-memory storage: books: dict[int, dict] and books_list: list[dict] ordered by id
GET /books handler: parse query params with urllib.parse.parse_qs; validate all params against allowed set {title, author, isbn, synopsis, q}; id param is rejected as unknown per S8

Filter: id param keeps only that id; field params keep books whose field contains value case-insensitively; q keeps books where any of the four fields contains value case-insensitively; all params must match simultaneously
Return 200 JSON list ordered by id; 404 for missing book or invalid path
Tests in tests/test_s4.py and tests/test_s8.py start the server on a free port via threading, run the request, and shut it down
